Flat feet can sometimes contribute to foot, knee, and back discomfort, but the right exercises may help improve strength, stability, and mobility. Learn how to strengthen your feet, support your arches, and move more comfortably with simple, practical techniques.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
